data.exact_reserve_text: Favourable prior year loss development of GBP 11.1 million was recorded in 2023 compared to favourable development of GBP 0.2 million in the prior calendar year. In the current calendar year, the favourable loss development was driven primarily by lower emergence of claims of certain lines of business than previously anticipated.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a modest gross release in prior year reserves in 2023. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows a net reduction in older underwriting year gross claims estimates of approximately GBP 7.9m (a c.1.25% release versus opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 631.1m). The managing agent's narrative reports favourable prior year loss development (GBP 11.1m) driven by lower-than-anticipated emergence of claims in certain lines of business (this figure in the narrative appears to be reported net of reinsurance). The gross triangle shows mixed movements across underwriting years with larger favourable development in several older years partially offset by deterioration in some mid-tailed years.
raw_causal_phrases: Favourable prior year loss development of GBP 11.1 million was recorded in 2023
driven primarily by lower emergence of claims of certain lines of business than previously anticipated

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development: the managing agent narrative (Note 5) reports a favourable prior year loss development of GBP 11.1m (text at page 36) but does not explicitly state whether that figure is gross or net. A gross claims development triangle is available (Claims development table - gross of reinsurance) and was used to compute a gross prior-year release of GBP 7.893m (calculated by comparing the current estimate to the previous diagonal for underwriting years 2013-2021). The narrative GBP 11.1m appears to be net of reinsurance whereas the triangle provides gross amounts. Lob mapping from the short 'Commercial' / 'Specialty' labels in the PYD table to standard Lloyd's LOBs is approximate and therefore assigned low confidence. The claims development triangle numbers are presented in the report in GBP '000; the prior_year_development_gbp_m here is converted to millions.
